title: Doozy Vape Co Mix Salts Cream Tobacco 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Doozy Mix Salts Cream Tobacco is a luxurious and indulgent e-liquid that combines the rich, smoky taste of tobacco with the smooth, velvety texture of cream. The result is a flavour that's both sophisticated and satisfying, with a subtle sweetness that lingers long on the palate. Doozy Mix Salts e-liquids’ 50/VG/50PG formulation delivers the perfect balance of flavour and cloud production while the nicotine salt formulation ensures a super-smooth and comfortable throat sensation. These e-liquids are perfect for use in starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than high-strength freebase liquids are capable of. With nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids a great choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by Nic salts. Experience the ultimate vaping pleasure with Doozy Vape Co's Mix collection, featuring a range of six timeless and delectable e-liquids that cater to those with a sweet tooth. From Tobacco and Confectionary to Drinks, Fruits, and Candy, these award-winning nic salts offer guilt-free indulgence that's sure to leave you blissfully satisfied. If you love this flavour, why not treat yourself to others in Doozy Vape Co’s Mix collection? From smooth and satisfying Cream Tobacco to juicy Mixed Berries and tangy Pink Lemonade, Mix are far too delicious to resist going back for more.
